player_queue.name: Dez Okonkwo
player_queue.reply: You think you're the first to try to get under my skin, Mayor? What's your business here?

player_queue.name: Dez Okonkwo
player_queue.reply: Demanding me what, exactly? You think you can just come in here and I'll roll over? What do you want, Mayor?

player_queue.name: Dez Okonkwo
player_queue.reply: That's not how it works around here, Mayor. You want me gone, you'll have to do better than just wanting it. What's the real reason you're after me?

laws.title: Quiet Hours in the Empty Lot
laws.text: No person may sit alone on the bench in the empty lot after midnight.
laws.because: Too many residents sitting alone on the cold bench all night.

laws.title: Counter Glass Prohibition
laws.text: No person shall leave an empty drinking glass unattended upon any public outdoor counter after snowfall begins.
laws.because: Unattended glasses left on the counter in the cold.

laws.title: Public Haircut Ban
laws.text: No person may cut hair in public spaces without a barber license.

laws.title: No Linger on Porch After Dusk
laws.text: No person may remain on a porch after 10:00 p.m. without a valid reason.
laws.because: Tariq "Tee" Bello convicted over Public Haircut Ban

laws.title: Pawnshop Window Contact Limit
laws.text: No person shall press palms or fingers against the display glass of any pawn shop on Delmar.
laws.because: People keep leaving handprints and body heat on the front window.

laws.title: Fountain Ledge Nightstand Ban
laws.text: No person may stand on the fountain ledge after 10:00 p.m.
laws.because: waits for water, nods to Ruiz

laws.title: Block Bedtime Ban
laws.text: No person may sleep in Block A or B after 10:00 p.m. without a valid reason.
laws.because: sleeping incidents in block A and B

laws.title: Bench Snow Gaze Regulation
laws.text: No person may sit on a public bench and stare at snowfall for more than fifteen minutes after 11:00 p.m.
laws.because: Dot Feeney taken to the 9th over Fountain Ledge Nightstand Ban

laws.title: Pocketknife Fidget Ban
laws.text: No person may fidget with a pocketknife in any public area after 10:00 p.m.

laws.title: Coffee on Bench Ban
laws.text: No person may drink coffee while seated on a public bench after 10:00 p.m.

laws.title: Public Inquiry About Lyle Ban
laws.text: No person shall publicly ask or seek information about Booker's business or personal affairs without written consent.
laws.because: Multiple residents asking about Lyle's affairs

laws.title: Car Exterior Finger Ban
laws.text: No person may touch a car's exterior with a finger in front of any auto shop without written permission.
laws.because: checks the dent in the car with a finger
